verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service could plausibly offer user-configured background automations, such as scheduled or automatic periodic report filings, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no such capability. Email notifications are only an adjacent alerting feature. The keyless business-entities data API is a developer building block hosted on the separate Socrata open-data platform, not a product-provided automation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
